description: This file contains utility functions for handling notifications via API calls, including fetching unread counts, listing notifications, and marking notifications as read.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL, typically ending with /api/v1.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL under the API base, ensuring proper slash formatting.

methods.name: fetchUnreadCount
methods.description: Fetches the count of unread notifications from the API.

methods.name: listNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications, filtered by status ('unread' or 'all').

methods.name: markNotificationRead
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read by its ID.
